description: This file defines the 'reqSpecCommands' class, which manages requirements specification commands within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, copying, reordering, freezing, and handling revisions of requirement specifications. The class interacts with database managers, handles GUI initialization, and processes user actions related to requirement specifications.

classes.name: reqSpecCommands
classes.description: Manages requirement specification commands including creation, editing, copying, reordering, freezing, and revisions within the TestLink project.

methods.name: setAuditContext
methods.description: Sets the audit context object used for logging audit events.

methods.name: getReqMgrSystem
methods.description: Returns the linked requirement manager system if enabled.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes a standard GUI object with default properties for requirement specification-related interfaces.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for creating a new requirement specification.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for editing an existing requirement specification.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new requirement specification, updating the database and GUI accordingly.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to an existing requirement specification, including validation, revision handling, and database updates.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement specification and logs the event.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Prepares the GUI for reordering requirement specifications.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Executes reordering of requirement specifications based on user input.

methods.name: createChild
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for creating a child requirement specification.

methods.name: copyRequirements
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for copying requirements within a requirement specification.

methods.name: doCopyRequirements
methods.description: Performs the copying of requirements to another location or specification.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for copying an entire requirement specification.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Executes copying of a requirement specification and its subtrees.

methods.name: doFreeze
methods.description: Freezes a requirement specification and optionally its child nodes, preventing further modifications.

methods.name: simpleCompare
methods.description: Compares two requirement specifications to determine if major attributes or custom fields have changed, suggesting whether a revision is needed.

methods.name: doCreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of a requirement specification with a provided log message.

methods.name: process_revision
methods.description: Processes the revision of a requirement specification, checking for attribute changes, and updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: fileUpload
methods.description: Handles file uploads related to requirement specifications.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an attached file from a requirement specification.

methods.name: initGuiObjForAttachmentOperations
methods.description: Initializes a GUI object for attachment management operations.

methods.name: bulkReqMon
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for bulk monitoring of requirements.

methods.name: doBulkReqMon
methods.description: Performs bulk monitoring actions on requirements.
